content:
maria_ops: Heads-up — after the CU12 image rollout finished in eu-west we started seeing provisioning failures on ~6 GPU nodes. Containers fail to start with: `nvidia: init failed: incompatible kernel module` and DKMS errors in the node bootstrap logs. Provisioner queue length jumped from 4 -> 40.
kevin_infra: Can you paste the exact error from the node? rootfs logs or kubelet events?
maria_ops: pasted from one node: \n```
Feb 25 12:03:10 node-42 kubelet[1234]: device-plugin registration failed: rpc error: code = Unknown desc = failed to load kernel module: modprobe: FATAL: Module nvidia not found in directory /lib/modules/5.15.0-1013
Feb 25 12:03:10 node-42 cloud-init[567]: dkms: ERROR: Cannot find module nvidia-535.101 for kernel 5.15.0-1013
```
kevin_infra: hmm. Most of our eu-west fleet is running 5.15.0-1013 apt kernels. The CU12 driver (535.x) build artifacts were targeted at kernels >=5.19 in the new packaging. Did the image builder pick a generic driver ABI? @deploy-bot which image tag rolled out to eu-west earlier?
deploy-bot: image-rollout: `redwood-cu12-runtime:2026-02-25` completed to eu-west at 12:00 UTC (rolling 20 nodes). :white_check_mark:
june_sre: We're also seeing downstream NCCL connect timeouts in heavy multi-GPU pods that did start: `NCCL WARN NET/Plugin : [Rank 1] -> [Rank 2] Connect failed (errno 22)` — could be mixed driver versions across nodes in the same job.
ryan_hw: Likely a kernel module mismatch: CU12 packaging expects newer kernel symbols. Two quick options: 1) roll back to the CU11 runtime image until we can rebuild drivers against 5.15, 2) rebuild kernel modules via DKMS on affected nodes (if compatible). Rolling back is fastest to unblock.
olivia_runtime: We have a hotfix branch to pin `redwood-cu11-runtime:stable` in the provisioning config for eu-west. If we patch the node pool config and trigger a scale update, new nodes will come up with cu11 images. Existing failed nodes need to be cordoned and drained.
maria_ops: Action plan proposal: 1) cordon the 6 failing nodes (node-42, node-51, node-57, node-61, node-88, node-99) 2) scale up a cu11-pinned pool + failover routing for the next 4 hours 3) collect `modinfo nvidia` and `uname -r` from a failing node and a healthy cu11 node and upload to the incident ticket.
kevin_infra: I'll collect outputs and paste. From failing node: \n```
$ uname -r
5.15.0-1013
$ modinfo nvidia || true
modinfo: ERROR: Module nvidia not found.
$ ls /lib/modules/5.15.0-1013 | grep nvidia || true
# empty
```
kevin_infra: Healthy cu11 node: \n```
$ uname -r
5.15.0-1013
$ modinfo nvidia
filename:       /lib/modules/5.15.0-1013/extra/nvidia.ko
version:        530.64
```
kevin_infra: So drivers for cu11 (530.x) exist on some nodes but not on others — indicates image build inconsistency. Maybe AKS/AMI cache served an old manifest for some hosts.
june_sre: We should also check whether kernel headers are present. DKMS will fail if `/usr/src/linux-headers-5.15.0-1013` missing.
ryan_hw: I'll run remote checkscript to validate headers and DKMS status and report back. If headers missing, rebuilding modules in-place isn't safe; rollback is more reliable.
maria_ops: I'm patching the pool now to pin to cu11, draining failing nodes. Will post results in 10m.
olivia_runtime: FYI I've queued an image-builder job to re-run CU12 driver packaging against our 5.15 CI kernels to produce a compatibility variant, but it will take ~24h to validate.
kevin_infra: Cost note — rollback + double-provisioning adds ~3 GPU-hours in eu-west for the next 6 hours. Finance flagged as acceptable for incident mitigation.
maria_ops: Update: cordoned + drained 4/6 nodes. New cu11 nodes provisioning healthy. Provision queue dropped to 6. Leaving this thread open until builders confirm CU12 compatibility variant.
ryan_hw: Remote checks show missing headers on the 2 still failing nodes. I'll attach the script output to the ticket.
june_sre: Also adding a temporary admission webhook to prevent mixing CU12 and CU11 nodes into the same pod topology (to avoid NCCL mixups) — rolling in 2m.
maria_ops: Thanks all. Follow-ups: (1) OLIVIA to validate CU12 rebuild artifacts tomorrow, (2) KEVIN to audit image cache/manifest logic, (3) RYAN to finish node diagnostics. Ping me if anything new. :thumbsup:
